description:
About the Position

This KTH postdoc develops mathematical tools for systems where learning algorithms, strategic participants and a changing environment affect one another. The project connects control, learning and game theory.

Research Position Overview

Model closed-loop interactions and study their consequences for stability, identifiability, robustness and coordination. Develop computational approaches for reliable system-level behaviour.

Research Areas

  • Systems and control
  • Machine learning and optimisation
  • Game theory and decision-making

Funding and Duration

Employment and financial support

Academic preparation and skills
ComponentDetails

Recruitment dates and location

How to Apply

  • CV/publications and a cover letter of at most one page.
  • Research statement: maximum two pages excluding references; diplomas/grades and three professional reference contacts.

Submit through the application button on the official recruitment page.

Selection and Contact

A doctorate awarded within the previous three years is preferred; teaching or mentoring experience is advantageous.

Project contact: Silun Zhang.

About KTH Royal Institute of Technology

The position is in KTH’s Department of Mathematics, with research in optimisation and mathematical systems theory and access to the WASP research programme.
